summary: John's maternal 3rd great-grandmother; daughter of a Bisaccia shepherd, mother of Frank Giannetta.
bio: Married Savino Giannetta at Bisaccia on 20 Jul 1867 (Matrimoni 1867, act 17) aged 18 (born c.1849); daughter of Bartolomeo Fede, pecoraio, and Luigia(?) Roberto. Living in 1896 when her son Frank married (act 18).
